name: raycast-dotfile-function-finder
title: Dotfile Function Finder
description: Search dotfile aliases, functions, and scripts by name or content, then copy or edit their source.
author: mikeoertli

commands.name: search-dotfiles
commands.title: Search Aliases, Functions and Scripts
commands.subtitle: Dotfile Function Finder
commands.description: Case-insensitive fuzzy or exact name search for aliases, functions, and scripts.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1

preferences.name: paths
preferences.title: Dotfile Search Paths
preferences.description: Files or folders separated by semicolons. Folders are searched recursively for shell files. Supports ~ and $HOME. Symlinks are indexed once; missing files are ignored.

preferences.name: scriptPaths
preferences.title: Script Search Directories
preferences.description: Optional script folders separated by semicolons. Searches recursively for common script extensions and shebang files (including extensionless scripts). Names include the filename extension.
